title: Unavailable, loading and recovery page
guidance: Keep one consistent page return and a clear content/recovery region. Remove duplicate unavailable-placeholder copy. Sparse pages must still fill the viewport and keep navigation at the bottom. Keep acceptable plain states restrained.
Unavailable panels align with normal page content and shared recovery style, not a centered narrow slab.

decisions.title: One page structure across recovery states
decisions.reason: Use top-left return, a clear page heading and one feedback/action group or restrained unavailable card. Avoid duplicate unavailable placeholders and redundant return buttons.

decisions.title: Short content does not pull navigation upward
decisions.reason: The host fills100dvh and reserves the measured fixed navigation height. Short/enlarged screens switch chrome to document flow.

decisions.title: Keep sparse states quiet
decisions.reason: A small contextual icon can help a sparse unavailable card. Do not add decorative filler or paragraphs solely to fill space.

decisions.title: 1.8 recovery anchoring
decisions.reason: Unavailable and empty panels start at the owning content edge, matching ordinary panel spacing; no centered narrow slab. Preserve appropriate page return and state-specific recovery/sign-in actions rather than forcing one generic recovery message.

parameters.name: Host sizing
parameters.description: Flex column root with min-height100dvh, growing main and measured nav clearance. Focused controls scroll clear of real chrome.

parameters.name: Narrow enlarged access card
parameters.description: Cap padding by viewport and provide full-width wrapping copy; do not clip Job unavailable.
